GTA V Story Mode is the single-player campaign set across Los Santos and Blaine County in Southern San Andreas. It follows Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor Philips, whose stories converge around heists, family conflicts, gang violence, and pressure from federal agents.
GTA V is set in Southern San Andreas. Los Santos is the main city, while Blaine County covers rural towns, desert, mountains, and the Alamo Sea to the north.
who are the main characters gta v
The three playable protagonists are Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor Philips. Each has separate money, stats, safehouses, activities, and a unique special ability.
how character switching works gta v

Story Mode lets you switch among Michael, Franklin, and Trevor once they are unlocked. Some missions require a particular protagonist, and mission markers use character colors: Michael blue, Franklin green, Trevor orange.
Mission marker colors identify the protagonist: blue for Michael, green for Franklin, and orange for Trevor. The current character's available markers are shown more prominently.
how many story missions gta v

Rockstar's completion checklist counts 69 Story Mode missions. Branching heist approaches and optional missions mean a playthrough can expose more individual mission entries than that checklist number.
For 100% completion, the checklist requires all 69 story missions, the required Franklin Strangers & Freaks content, 42 hobbies and pastimes, any 14 random events, and 16 miscellaneous tasks.
how saves work gta v story

Story Mode supports autosaves, manual saves at safehouse beds, and Quick Save through the phone. Keeping separate manual slots before heists, assassinations, and ending choices is useful because several decisions have lasting consequences.

Story Mode is the three-protagonist single-player campaign. GTA Online uses a player-created character, separate progression, businesses, properties, vehicles, missions, and an evolving online economy. Content should not be assumed to exist in both modes.

PC Legacy and Enhanced share the core GTA V story, but Enhanced adds newer technical features and some edition-specific content. Franklin should identify the edition before claiming that an Enhanced-only feature exists in Legacy.

Michael De Santa is formerly Michael Townley, a retired bank robber living under a new identity in Rockford Hills after a deal connected to the failed 2004 North Yankton robbery. He is drawn back into crime and becomes a mentor figure to Franklin.

Franklin Clinton is a young Los Santos hustler and repossession worker from South Los Santos who wants to move beyond small-time street crime. His relationship with Michael becomes central to the story.

Trevor Philips is Michael's former robbery partner, a volatile former military pilot who runs Trevor Philips Enterprises from Sandy Shores and becomes entangled with gangs, cartels, and the protagonists' old history.
Lester Crest is a highly skilled planner and hacker who organizes the protagonists' major heists and gives Franklin the assassination missions tied to stock-market manipulation.
Lamar Davis is Franklin's close friend and fellow Families member. His impulsive plans repeatedly pull Franklin back into South Los Santos gang conflicts.
Chop is Lamar's Rottweiler who later stays with Franklin. Chop appears in the story mission Chop and can be walked and played with in free roam.
Amanda De Santa is Michael's wife. Their strained marriage and family problems are major parts of Michael's story arc.
Jimmy De Santa is Michael and Amanda's son, a lazy gamer whose behavior causes several family-related missions and conflicts.
Tracey De Santa is Michael and Amanda's daughter, who wants fame and appears in story and family missions including Fame or Shame.
Dave Norton is an FIB agent tied to Michael's past and the secret arrangement that helped Michael disappear after North Yankton.
Steve Haines is an ambitious and corrupt FIB agent who forces the protagonists into operations against the IAA and other targets.
Devin Weston is a wealthy investor and major antagonist who hires the protagonists for vehicle theft jobs and later pressures Franklin to kill Michael.
Martin Madrazo is a powerful Mexican-American cartel boss whose house Michael damages, creating the debt that motivates the Jewel Store Job.
Patricia Madrazo is Martin Madrazo's wife. Trevor develops an unusual attachment to her after taking her away from Martin.
Solomon Richards is an aging film producer at Richards Majestic whom Michael helps during his attempt to enter the movie business.
Simeon Yetarian is owner of Premium Deluxe Motorsport and Franklin's employer at the start of the story. He runs a predatory car-financing and repossession business.
Harold 'Stretch' Joseph is a former Families member whose return from prison worsens tensions around Lamar and Franklin and eventually reveals his betrayal.
Tanisha Jackson is Franklin's former girlfriend and a symbol of the more stable life Franklin is trying to reach.
Ron Jakowski is Trevor's nervous friend and business associate in Sandy Shores, involved in aircraft and arms-trafficking operations.
Wade Hebert is Trevor's naive associate who helps locate Michael in Los Santos and later accompanies Trevor to the city.
Floyd Hebert is Wade's cousin. Trevor takes over Floyd's Vespucci apartment while operating in Los Santos.
Chef is Trevor's associate and a capable gunman who can later become available as a heist crew member.
Brad Snider is a member of Michael and Trevor's old robbery crew whose fate in North Yankton becomes central to the conflict between Michael and Trevor.
Johnny Klebitz is former protagonist of The Lost and Damned and leader associated with The Lost MC; his encounter with Trevor helps establish Trevor's destructive return.
Wei Cheng is leader of the Los Santos Triads. His organization becomes involved with Trevor's drug business and later the story's final conflicts.
Tao Cheng is Wei Cheng's son, sent to evaluate potential drug suppliers in Blaine County.
Ortega is a Varrios Los Aztecas leader in Blaine County who competes with Trevor over the local arms and drug trade.
Elwood O'Neil is one of the surviving O'Neil brothers and part of the rival meth operation based at O'Neil Ranch in Grapeseed.
Molly Schultz is Devin Weston's lawyer and assistant, involved in the film-studio conflict with Michael.
Dr. Isiah Friedlander is Michael's therapist. Optional therapy sessions comment on Michael's behavior and relationships.
Cris Formage is leader of the Epsilon Program, the cult-like organization encountered in Michael's Epsilon Strangers & Freaks storyline.
Omega is an eccentric alien enthusiast who asks Franklin to collect 50 Spaceship Parts.
Maude Eccles is a bounty hunter who gives Trevor Bail Bond targets to capture or kill.
Beverly Felton is a paparazzo who gives Franklin celebrity photography missions.
